As equities reel in response to his resignation following extramarital affairs, alleged Chinese espionage and a summons to testify before US lawmakers, questions mount over who is really in charge of tech and whether the immense capital riding on it can survive the turmoil.

news.title: Ajuste fiscal é compatível com promessas de Lula, diz André Esteves
news.summary: Chairman afirma que presidente pode cumprir compromissos assumidos na campanha e adotar medidas para equilibrar as contas

news.title: Al menos 50 heridos en un ataque ruso sobre la provincia ucraniana de Zaporiyia
news.summary: El gobernador interino de la provincia de Zaporiyia, Mijailo Semikin, ha elevado a 50 el número de heridos como consecuencia de un ataque ruso que ha impactado en un edificio residencial en el distrito de Kosmichni.

news.title: November 13 Paris attacks: Eleven years later, France pays tribute to victims
news.summary: Eleven years on, France pays tribute to the victims of the November 13 attacks. French officials, victims’ associations and families gathered this Friday to pay their respects to those killed in the attacks in Paris on November 13, 2015.

news.title: Crossing Afghanistan along the 'highway of death'
news.summary: Highway 1, or the Ring Road, connects Afghanistan's major cities. After September 11, 2001, it became a hotspot for crime and fighting, particularly between the capital Kabul and Kandahar, the Taliban's birthplace. People taking it had to navigate extortions, kidnappings and suicide bombings. What has become of the road after the US-led war and five years of Taliban rule? Our former Afghanistan correspondent Claire Billet and photojournalist Sandra Calligaro returned to the country to find out.

news.title: Emendas impositivas causam embates entre Poderes, diz Gilmar
news.summary: Ministro relaciona disputas sobre o Orçamento federal a conflitos entre Executivo e Legislativo que acabam chegando ao Judiciário

news.title: Car bombings in Russia kill military officer, injure ex-Ukraine PM adviser
news.summary: Moscow blames Kyiv for a series of car bombings that have targeted people linked to the war with Ukraine.

news.title: Myanmar: Junta carries out double-tap airstrikes targeting civilians
news.summary: Numerous civilian casualties have been documented in Rakhine State amid a renewed military offensive by the junta to regain control of the area. Available evidence suggests that military aircraft are deliberately targeting civilian sites and carrying out double-tap strikes.

news.title: Rosenberg: Uncompromising Putin ups demands for peace with Ukraine
news.summary: The fact the question of European security now features in discussions is viewed in Moscow as a victory, BBC Russia Editor Steve Rosenberg says.

news.title: El Niño fuels climate disasters: The high price of inaction
news.summary: 2026 is set to be one of the hottest years on record, with El Niño worsening the impact of extreme weather events. With COP31 underway in Turkey, FRANCE 24 speaks with the UNDP's climate boss about the cost of waiting in a warmer world, and with one of the student activists from Pacific Island nations who took their climate fight to the UN's highest court, and won.

news.title: Jerusalem Daily: Baby dies from cold in Gaza
news.summary: A baby dies from the cold in Gaza as 53 countries urge Israel to allow aid in.

news.title: Sixth victim confirmed in DC condo-related shooting in US, police say
news.summary: Police confirm sixth victim in DC condo shooting; suspect dead after barricading himself and starting a fire.

news.title: US Treasury warns against rate hikes during US-Iran war energy ‘shock’
news.summary: Despite Treasury's Scott Bessent's remarks, financial tracker CME Fed Watch forecasts rate hike in December likely.

news.title: Rusia desmiente a EEUU y deja en el aire la incorporación europea a las negociaciones sobre Ucrania
news.summary: El Gobierno ruso ha desmentido este viernes que haya alcanzado un acuerdo con la mediación estadounidense sobre una posible incorporación europea a la próxima ronda de negociaciones sobre Ucrania.

news.title: West Bank: ‘Without international trade and financial support, large settlements would not exist’
news.summary: France is considering legislation to restrict trade with Israeli settlements in the occupied Palestinian territories, namely the West Bank. Ivar Ekeland, Professor Emeritus at Paris Dauphine-PSL University and Chair of the Organization of Academics for the Respect of International Law in Palestine, discusses the proposed measures with Alison Sargent. He calls for restrictions to cover n ot only goods but also services, including financial services, insurance and tourism. "Without the support of financial entities, of insurance, of providing goods and so on, settlements, big settlements, would not exist," he argues.

news.title: Sombra do impeachment volta à cena nos EUA após derrota eleitoral de Trump
news.summary: Nova maioria democrata no Congresso pode abrir caminho a processos de destituição contra membros do governo Trump e até contra o próprio presidente.

news.title: High airfares may become new norm as jet fuel costs soar, says Asia-Pacific airline industry chief
news.summary: High airfares could become the new norm as airlines contend with soaring jet fuel prices and mounting operating costs, the Association of Asia Pacific Airlines' chief said Friday.

news.title: Truck and bus crash in India’s Assam state kills at least 24 people
news.summary: Several children and the bus driver were among those killed, officials said, with the death toll expected to rise.

news.title: UN refugee chief Barham Salih slams 'shameful' war in Sudan, urges 'political solution'
news.summary: In an interview with FRANCE 24, UN refugee chief Barham Salih called the war in Sudan "shameful" and urged the world to end it. With forced displacement at a record high, he warned that funding cuts are hurting people "in dire need". "Efficiency has its limits," he said. Salih also defended the "integrity of the asylum system".

news.title: France asks Brussels to examine Algeria's non-compliance of EU association agreement
news.summary: France announced on Friday that it will ask the European Commission to "examine" Algeria's non-compliance with its EU association agreement. Earlier in July, Algiers imposed a near-blanket ban on French imports, and last month, Algeria suspended urea shipments to France.

news.title: Nvidia scandal: How close was ex-CEO to Trump?
news.summary: US lawmakers have called Jensen Huang to face their questions in December after the Nvidia ex-CEO quit over extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy. The Taiwanese-born businessman was a close informal adviser to President Donald Trump on AI and had spent years lobbying against curbs on sales of advanced AI chips to China for national security reasons. Just how close Huang was to Trump and the extent of the influence tech giants have on his administration are some of the questions that still need answering, says France 24’s Douglas Herbert.

news.title: Turkiye and Qatar sign mutual defence agreement
news.summary: The pact was signed after ​the President met Qatari Emir Sheikh Tamim ‌‌bin Hamad ​Al Thani in Istanbul on ⁠⁠Friday.

news.title: Russia strikes targets across Ukraine as Kyiv launches nearly 1,200 drones
news.summary: Russian strikes hit targets across Ukraine on Thursday, with one attack damaging a hospital. Ukraine meanwhile fired almost 1,200 drones at Russian targets overnight in one of its biggest aerial attacks since Moscow’s full-scale invasion nearly five years ago.

news.title: Europe seeks seat at Ukraine peace talks but lacks unified voice
news.summary: EU leaders believe a US-backed process will allow Moscow and Washington to decide the fate of a conflict.

news.title: German spies handed new powers to tackle 'hybrid threats' from abroad
news.summary: German reforms mean foreign and domestic intelligence services will have greater powers to combat espionage, terrorism and sabotage.

news.title: Why does El Salvador's Bukele have troops in Haiti?
news.summary: Haiti's Prime Minister congratulating El Salvador's President for a gang crackdown in Haiti has shone a light on the relationship between the two countries. What's going on, and where does the US stand?

news.title: Iran targeted US radar system in Bahrain
news.summary: Iran claimed it struck US radar systems in Bahrain, while the US said it had intercepted the attacks. Clashes continue in the Strait of Hormuz, as the war remains in a state of de-escalation.

news.title: Beijing faces its Russia dilemma amid talk of Xi-Trump-Putin summit
news.summary: China is forced to tread carefully as it considers hosting a meeting between Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin, and Donald Trump. While the optics are sure to favor Moscow, Beijing is risking its image at the global stage.

news.title: Outlook voltou: por que demorou para Microsoft resolver o problema?
news.summary: Após mais de 20 horas de instabilidade, serviço começa a ser restabelecido, mas alguns usuários ainda enfrentam dificuldades; especialista explica como a sobrecarga de servidores pode prolongar a recuperação.

news.summary: Problema começou na quinta-feira e ainda afeta serviços como o sistema de mensagens Teams, o Microsoft 365 e a ferramenta de inteligência artificial Copilot em diversos países.

news.title: At least 24 killed after bus collides with truck in north-east India
news.summary: Several of the deceased are college students, according to local official Atul Bora, but they have not yet been publicly identified.

news.title: Watch: Divers explore US ship sunk off Florida coast to create new reef
news.summary: The ship was intentionally sunk off the coast of Florida in order to create the world's largest artificial ocean reef.
